title: HHAs & PCAs needed in Nassau County
description:
Alvita Care is seeking New York employees for per diem HHAs & PCAs -- we're hiring for experienced, empathetic, and proactive professionals!

If you are interested or curious about any job details, please apply or reach out directly to May Dichoso 332-330-1982 or email your resume to may.dichoso@alvitacare.com!

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Valid HHA or PCA Certificate
  • Must live in or near Nassau County 
  • Availability for Day Shifts
  • Driver is a plus!
  • Must be discrete and professional in all communications, written and verbal
  • Must have updated medicals/vaccinations or be willing to obtain
  • Completed drug screen or completed Habituation Form
  • Must successfully complete Alvita Care process to accept cases

DETAILS:

  • Per diem day shifts 8-12 hours
  • M-F availability is nice, but weekends are a plus!
  • Good tech skills, and proactivity are all helpful
  • Weekly paycheck on Fridays (direct deposit, debit pay card, or paper check)

If you are interested or curious about any job details, please apply or reach out directly to May Dichoso 332-330-1982 or email your resume to may.dichoso@alvitacare.com!

Some Additional benefits to look forward to:

  • Medical / health benefits available*
  • Sick time – up to 56 hours per year of sick time per year based on hours worked
  • 401(k) with company match **
  • Fast onboarding process to get you working ASAP

* subject to one-year employment and 1,560 hours worked (30 hours / week average)
** - subject to one-year employment and 1,000 hours worked (20 hours/ week average)

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Alvita Care is a mission-driven Home Healthcare & Personal Care Agency with four branches and over 500 caregivers. We provide relief and assurance to family members in the areas of In-Home Personal Care, Alzheimer's & Dementia Care, Palliative & Hospice Care, and Geriatric Care Management and have earned The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval. Alvita Care clients are all private-pay and we do not accept Medicare or Medicaid.

As we expand our circle of care, we are seeking top-notch caregivers to service our NYC needs. We have private-duty one-on-one care cases available as well as facility based care cases.

All applicants are subject to a phone screening to determine compatibility and overall availability of accommodations for both the caregiver and the agency. Please note that cases with Alvita Care are only available to caregivers who successfully complete the onboarding process.

title: LPN (Licensed Practical Nurse) Per Diem
description:
Alvita Care IS HIRING!

We are looking for Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs) who are caring, compassionate and dedicated to work with our clients across the Long Island area, specifically around Bayport, Port Jefferson, and surrounding areas.

If you're interested or want to discuss details, please reach out to May Dichoso at 332 330 1982 or may.dichoso@alvitacare.com

Details :

  • Seeking experienced LPN available for per diem shift work
  • Private duty homecare, with possibility for facility/nursing home shifts, and private hospital bedsides
  • Primary needs with these shifts will be medication management, geriatric and post-surgical care, and professional coordination with other providers (OT/PT/hospice/etc)
  • Shift work is paid between $40-45/hour
  • We also have a generous referral bonus program so bring a friend and get paid!
  • Feeding tube experience (G-tube, J-tube, PEG) preferred

 

Shifts:

  • We will have 8-12 hour day or night shifts
  • Availability for 12 hour days 3-4 days/week preferred
Requirements:
  • New York State Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) License
  • One of: BLS, CPR, PALS and/or ACLS certifications
  •  
Alvita Care is expanding! Every day we get more and more cases and are in need of GREAT nurses like yourself! If this job does not interest you, reach out to us as we may have other cases that more closely fit your experience and location needs!
  • Please reach out with any questions or concerns
  • If you're interested or want to discuss details, please reach out to May Dichoso at 332 330 1982 or may.dichoso@alvitacare.com
